<div
    id="block_d8519d64576cf14d958f0be5338d5611"
    class="block-ie-our-story">

        <div class="container-fluid wrapper ie-ptb-none">
        <div class="row">
            <div class="col-md-12">
                <div class="block-title">
                    <h2 class="title">Our story</h2>                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="row d-flex justify-content-between">
            <div class="col-md-5">
                <div class="image-wrap">
                    <img decoding="async" class="img-fluid" src="https://s46182.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Indexers-talking-1600x900-v2.jpg" alt="Employees sitting on steps">                </div>
                <div class="image-caption">
                    <p></p>                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="col-md-6">
                <div class="content-wrap">
                    <p><p>Index Exchange was born out of a need for an advertising marketplace that was fair and balanced. We saw the opportunity to create an exchange that empowered media owners to thrive in the digital age, while delivering unparalleled efficiency, transparency, and value across the entire programmatic ecosystem.</p>
<p>From the very beginning, we’ve worked to build exceptional standards that deliver on our vision of total market efficiency. By pioneering header bidding, advancing industry protocols, creating opportunities for addressable campaigns, and eliminating made-for-advertising supply, we’ve been relentless in raising the bar for programmatic excellence.</p>
<p>Today, that same focus is driving the next evolution of our exchange. With Index Cloud, partners can run their technology directly within our infrastructure—bringing intelligence closer to the impression and enabling a new model for more efficient and performant sell-side decisioning.</p>
<p>As we continue to accelerate the evolution of ad technology across every channel, our focus remains on setting the standard for the industry—from inventory quality to transparency to a level playing field where all participants can compete and grow with confidence.</p>
</p>                </div>

</div>

<p>Andrew Casale founded Casale Media, an ad network driven to solve problems of scale and efficiency for publishers and support the open web.<br />

<h3 style="margin-bottom: 16px">Launched Index Platform by Casale Media</h3>
<p>Pivoting from the ad network model as programmatic emerged, we introduced Index Platform, enabling real-time transactions between media owners and marketers.<br />
<img decoding="async" style="margin-top: 30px" src="https://s46182.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/index-timeline-50px_2011-index-platform.png" alt="Index Platform" width="190" height="50" /></p>

<h3 style="margin-bottom: 16px">Co-authored OpenRTB specifications</h3>
<p>Identifying the need for industry-wide programmatic standards, we helped to co-author the OpenRTB specifications.<br />
<img decoding="async" style="margin-top: 30px" src="https://s46182.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/index-timeline-50px_2011-OpenRTB-specs.png" alt="OpenRTB" width="125" height="50" /></p>

<h3 style="margin-bottom: 16px">Evolved into Index Exchange</h3>
<p>Casale Media officially rebranded as Index Exchange, and the legacy ad network was shut down.<br />
<img decoding="async" style="margin-top: 30px" src="https://s46182.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/index-timeline-50px_2015-evolved-into-index-exchange.png" alt="Index Exchange" width="194" height="50" /></p>

<h3 style="margin-bottom: 16px">Pioneered header bidding and launched the Wrapper</h3>
<p>We worked to standardize and accelerate adoption of header bidding, launching the Wrapper to improve performance and revenue for our customers.<br />
<img decoding="async" style="margin-top: 30px" src="https://s46182.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/index-timeline-50px_2016-index-wrapper.png" alt="Header Bidding" width="165" height="50" /></p>

<h3 style="margin-bottom: 16px">Launched IX Labs venture arm</h3>
<p>As the venture arm of Index, IX Labs aims to accelerate the adoption of technology across the world to solve everyday problems.<br />
<img decoding="async" style="margin-top: 30px" src="https://s46182.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/index-timeline-50px_2019-ix-labs.png" alt="IX Labs" width="118" height="50" /></p>

<h3 style="margin-bottom: 16px">Earned “TAG Platinum” status</h3>
<p>Building on the quality standards we established early on, we achieved Platinum status with the Trustworthy Accountability Group, becoming one of only eight companies to achieve this status.<br />
<img decoding="async" style="margin-top: 30px" src="https://s46182.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/index-timeline-50px_2019-tag-platinum.png" alt="TAG Platinum Status" width="152" height="50" /></p>

<p>We launched Client Audit Logs (CALs) to provide a receipt for every transaction, further enhancing transparency in programmatic.<br />

<h3 style="margin-bottom: 16px">Rebuilt our exchange for omnichannel scale</h3>
<p>We rebuilt our exchange architecture, debuting a modern omnichannel exchange to harness the scale of new channels like streaming TV, and launched a new brand identity to reflect our full offerings.<br />
<img decoding="async" style="margin-top: 30px" src="https://s46182.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/index-timeline-50px_2021-rebuilt-exchange.png" alt="Index Exchange" width="110" height="50" /></p>

<h3 style="margin-bottom: 16px">Co-authored OpenRTB 2.6 to accelerate standards in streaming TV</h3>
<p>We helped develop the OpenRTB 2.6 protocol, creating standardization around a host of new capabilities for streaming TV, including ad podding.<br />

<h3 style="margin-bottom: 16px">Acquired Rivr, an advanced machine learning company</h3>
<p>We made our first-ever business acquisition with Rivr, advancing our use of machine learning to improve programmatic outcomes.<br />
<img decoding="async" style="margin-top: 30px" src="https://s46182.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/index-timeline-50px_2022-Rivr.png" alt="Rivr" width="115" height="50" /></p>
					</div>

									</div>
			</div>
		
			<div class="carousel-cell">
				<div class="wrapper">
					<div class="content">
						<p><img decoding="async" src="https://s46182.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/timeline-2024-horz.png" alt="2024" /></p>
<h3 style="margin-bottom: 16px">Launched Index Marketplaces</h3>
<p>Our omnichannel Index Marketplaces platform opened new opportunities for sell-side decisioning, enabling businesses to build atop our platform to scale their solutions for curation, data activation, AI algorithms, carbon measurement, and many others.<br />
<img decoding="async" style="margin-top: 30px" src="https://s46182.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/index-timeline-50px_2024-index-marketplaces.png" alt="Index Marketplaces" width="149" height="50" /></p>
					</div>

									</div>
			</div>
		
			<div class="carousel-cell">
				<div class="wrapper">
					<div class="content">
						<p><img decoding="async" src="https://s46182.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/timeline-2024-horz.png" alt="2024" /></p>
<h3 style="margin-bottom: 16px">Eliminated MFA across Index Exchange</h3>
<p>We eliminated made-for-advertising (MFA) sites across our exchange, reinforcing our commitment to transparency and support for publishers.<br />
<img decoding="async" style="margin-top: 30px" src="https://s46182.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/index-timeline-50px_2024-no-mfa.png" alt="No MFA" width="63" height="50" /></p>
					</div>

									</div>
			</div>
		
			<div class="carousel-cell">
				<div class="wrapper">
					<div class="content">
						<p><img decoding="async" src="https://s46182.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/timeline-2026-horz.png" alt="2026" /></p>
<h3 style="margin-bottom: 16px">Launched Index Cloud in closed beta</h3>
<p>With Index Cloud, partners can deploy their own models, data, and logic directly in the exchange—providing the autonomy of the public cloud, but without the latency, signal loss, cost premiums, and added overhead of running outside from the auction.<br />
<img decoding="async" style="margin-top: 30px" src="https://s46182.pcdn.co/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/index-timeline-cloud-64x50-1.png" alt="Index Cloud" width="63" height="50" /></p>
					</div>

Contact en USA FRA DEU ITA ESP AUS GBR JPN CAN Login Login en USA FRA DEU ITA ESP AUS GBR JPN CAN About Index We’re a globally trusted supply-side platform powering intelligent decisioning to maximize value for media owners and deliver stronger outcomes for buyers. We’re a globally trusted supply-side platform powering intelligent decisioning to maximize value for media owners and deliver stronger outcomes for buyers. Our vision is total market efficiency With more than 20 years of industry leadership, we continue to accelerate the ad technology evolution by applying intelligence closer to the impression and reducing waste across the supply chain. Our massive scale, transparent pricing, and advanced infrastructure allow us to eliminate inefficiency and reduce costs–and we pass those savings on to our customers. Maximizing working media for marketers and growing revenue for media owners means we’re able to help power the digital content and experiences that consumers enjoy all over the world. The Index difference Open to change 01 Open to change 01 Change is inevitable. Evolution is a requirement. We remain nimble, ready to lead the transformation for the good of our customers and the industry. Dedicated to innovation 02 Dedicated to innovation 02 We pursue disruption with purpose and intention. As an engineering-first company, we build to advance the industry. We proudly own and operate our own infrastructure to deliver on our promise of efficiency. Committed to transparency 03 Committed to transparency 03 With our radically transparent business practices and unsurpassed supply chain visibility, we’re committed to upholding integrity and trust throughout the programmatic ecosystem. Fueled by collaboration 04 Fueled by collaboration 04 We collaborate with parties throughout the ad tech ecosystem to develop solutions and standards that change the industry for the better. Local presence with global reach With teams around the world, Index combines on-the-ground support with international scale to help media owners and buyers connect with consumers across the globe. See all locations Our story Index Exchange was born out of a need for an advertising marketplace that was fair and balanced. We saw the opportunity to create an exchange that empowered media owners to thrive in the digital age, while delivering unparalleled efficiency, transparency, and value across the entire programmatic ecosystem. From the very beginning, we’ve worked to build exceptional standards that deliver on our vision of total market efficiency. By pioneering header bidding, advancing industry protocols, creating opportunities for addressable campaigns, and eliminating made-for-advertising supply, we’ve been relentless in raising the bar for programmatic excellence. Today, that same focus is driving the next evolution of our exchange. With Index Cloud, partners can run their technology directly within our infrastructure—bringing intelligence closer to the impression and enabling a new model for more efficient and performant sell-side decisioning. As we continue to accelerate the evolution of ad technology across every channel, our focus remains on setting the standard for the industry—from inventory quality to transparency to a level playing field where all participants can compete and grow with confidence. Our history Founded as Casale Media Andrew Casale founded Casale Media, an ad network driven to solve problems of scale and efficiency for publishers and support the open web. Launched Index Platform by Casale Media Pivoting from the ad network model as programmatic emerged, we introduced Index Platform, enabling real-time transactions between media owners and marketers. Co-authored OpenRTB specifications Identifying the need for industry-wide programmatic standards, we helped to co-author the OpenRTB specifications. Joined the IAB Tech Lab as a founding member We joined the IAB Tech Lab as a founding member, with Andrew Casale serving on the inaugural Board of Directors. Evolved into Index Exchange Casale Media officially rebranded as Index Exchange, and the legacy ad network was shut down. Pioneered header bidding and launched the Wrapper We worked to standardize and accelerate adoption of header bidding, launching the Wrapper to improve performance and revenue for our customers. Launched IX Labs venture arm As the venture arm of Index, IX Labs aims to accelerate the adoption of technology across the world to solve everyday problems. Earned “TAG Platinum” status Building on the quality standards we established early on, we achieved Platinum status with the Trustworthy Accountability Group, becoming one of only eight companies to achieve this status. Introduced Client Audit Logs We launched Client Audit Logs (CALs) to provide a receipt for every transaction, further enhancing transparency in programmatic. Rebuilt our exchange for omnichannel scale We rebuilt our exchange architecture, debuting a modern omnichannel exchange to harness the scale of new channels like streaming TV, and launched a new brand identity to reflect our full offerings. Co-authored OpenRTB 2.6 to accelerate standards in streaming TV We helped develop the OpenRTB 2.6 protocol, creating standardization around a host of new capabilities for streaming TV, including ad podding. Acquired Rivr, an advanced machine learning company We made our first-ever business acquisition with Rivr, advancing our use of machine learning to improve programmatic outcomes. Launched Index Marketplaces Our omnichannel Index Marketplaces platform opened new opportunities for sell-side decisioning, enabling businesses to build atop our platform to scale their solutions for curation, data activation, AI algorithms, carbon measurement, and many others. Eliminated MFA across Index Exchange We eliminated made-for-advertising (MFA) sites across our exchange, reinforcing our commitment to transparency and support for publishers. Launched Index Cloud in closed beta With Index Cloud, partners can deploy their own models, data, and logic directly in the exchange—providing the autonomy of the public cloud, but without the latency, signal loss, cost premiums, and added overhead of running outside from the auction. Our leadership team Our team is steeped in tech experience with a keen understanding of how to navigate the ever-evolving nuances of the market. Meet the team Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging Index is committed to creating actionable DEI&B programs and leading the exchange of ideas. DEI&B in our workplace Sustainability We’re committed to investing in a sustainable and climate-conscious future, and believe our industry has an important role to play in driving change. Sustainability at Index IX Labs IX Labs is the investment arm of Index Exchange and aims to accelerate the adoption of technology across the world to solve everyday problems. Learn more about IX Labs Careers Changing the ad tech industry starts with our people. Our team has led the way through new challenges and shifts in the market—and we’re growing quickly as we continue on our journey. Are you ready for your next challenge?
